agreement.revokedByPartnerSubtitle: Only {name} can start a new agreement now.
agreement.revokedSubtitle: You can start a new one.
agreement.newSubtitle: You each fill in your part separately. You'll only see what you both agree on.
agreement.logisticsChangedTitle: You're changing the time, place or rules
agreement.logisticsChangedSubtitle: {name} will have to confirm them again.
agreement.confirmedTitle: You've both filled in the agreement
agreement.confirmedSubtitle: Once you're there, either of you can change your mind at any time.
agreement.myPartDoneSubtitle: {name} hasn't filled in or confirmed theirs yet.
agreement.partnerFilledSubtitle: Fill in yours – you'll only see what you both agree on.
agreement.fillSubtitle: You'll only see what you both agree on.
agreement.overlapMaybe: Maybe – you'll talk it through when you're there
agreement.overlapHint: Nobody sees what one of you doesn't want – not even who it was.
agreement.wishesHint: {name} will only see what you both agree on. Nobody will see your "no".
agreement.wishesHintNoName: The other person will only see what you both agree on.
agreement.noteLabel: My boundaries (the other person sees these too)
agreement.notePlaceholder: E.g. no photos, I want to get to know you first.
agreement.logisticsLabel: Practical stuff – applies to both of you
agreement.publicFirstHint: A café or bar – you decide in person whether to carry on.
agreement.partnerMayShare: During the meetup, {name} can share your name, photo and the meeting place with their trusted contact.
agreement.revokeConfirmMessage: The meetup is off. You don't have to explain anything – {name} only gets a notification.

meetup.title: Meetup · {name}
meetup.endedMessage: {name} got a message that you're OK.
meetup.sosFailed: The alarm couldn't be sent: {error} Try again or call {name}.
meetup.needAgreementSubtitle: You can start the meetup once you've both filled in and confirmed the agreement.
meetup.setupSubtitle: A trusted contact, a PIN and a duress PIN.
meetup.pointTrusted: {name} gets a text with a link. They'll see where you are, who you're with and whether you're OK.
meetup.pointTrustedNoName: Your trusted contact gets a text with a link. They'll see where you are, who you're with and whether you're OK.
meetup.pointCheckIn: At regular intervals, you confirm with your PIN that you're OK. If you don't check in, we send an alert – even if your phone dies.
meetup.pointDuress: The duress PIN looks exactly like your normal one, but silently raises the alarm.
meetup.pointPartner: {name} will see that you have safety mode on and that your trusted contact knows where you are and who you're with. Nothing more – not the alarm, not your location.
meetup.bgLocationTitle: Location only while the app is open
meetup.bgLocationSubtitle: Set location access to "Always" so they can see it even when your screen is off.
meetup.overdueHint: {name} has been alerted. Confirm with your PIN that you're OK.

graceHint.one: If you don't check in within {count} minute of the due time, {name} gets an alert with your location.
graceHint.other: If you don't check in within {count} minutes of the due time, {name} gets an alert with your location.

meetup.partnerSafetyOn: {name} has safety mode on too – their trusted contact knows where they are and who they're with.
meetup.fakeCallHint: In {count} s, the fake call rings just like a real call – your excuse to leave.
meetup.sosSentBody: {trusted} has received your exact location and who you're with. {partner} won't see anything.
meetup.sosMistake: It was a mistake – I'm OK
meetup.pinSubtitleEnd: That the meetup is over and you're OK.
meetup.revokeConfirmMessage: {name} will get a notification. You don't have to explain anything. Safety mode keeps running until you end it.

feedback.title: How did the meetup go?
feedback.privacy: Only our team sees your answer – {name} never will. It helps us keep this a place for people who respect boundaries.
feedback.privacyNoName: Only our team sees your answer – the other person never will. It helps us keep this a place for people who respect boundaries.
feedback.preserve: Keep the record of the meetup in case you need to go to the police. Otherwise the agreement is deleted after 48 hours.
feedback.suspendNotice: If someone didn't respect you or you're in danger, we'll suspend their account right away and look into it.
feedback.helpIntro: We'll look into it, and we've suspended the other person's account while we review it. You don't have to decide right now what to do next – and none of this is your fault.

whiteCircle.name: Helpline for victims of crime – Bílý kruh bezpečí
whiteCircle.detail: 24/7, free, and you can stay anonymous.

police.name: Czech Police
police.detail: If you want to report it – even later.

persefona.name: Persefona
persefona.detail: Support for people who have experienced sexual violence.

helpLocal.name: Where to get help
helpLocal.detail: Contact the local police or a local support line for victims of crime and sexual violence.

feedback.medical: If something happened against your will, get medical help as soon as you can – also to prevent pregnancy and infections, as some medication only works within 72 hours. Evidence can still be collected if you haven't showered yet and you keep your clothes. But none of this is a requirement – you can report it later, too.
feedback.preserved: We've kept the record of the meetup (agreement, messages, alarms) in case you need it for the police.

report.title: Report
report.intro: Your report is anonymous. We'll also block them for you, so you won't see each other anymore.
report.introWithName: {name}. Your report is anonymous. We'll also block them for you, so you won't see each other anymore.
report.thanksMessage: We've received your report. You won't see each other anymore.

chat.blockConfirmMessage: You and {name} won't see each other anymore, and the chat will disappear.

safetySettings.title: Safety and privacy
safetySettings.trustedHint: When you start a meetup, we'll text them a link to your location. We'll alert them if you don't check in or if you raise the alarm.
safetySettings.pinsHint: During a meetup, you use your PIN to confirm you're OK. The duress PIN looks exactly the same but silently sends an alarm – use it if someone is forcing you to tell the app everything's fine.
safetySettings.appLockHint: Face ID, fingerprint or your phone's passcode every time you open the app.
safetySettings.discreetHint: A neutral icon and notifications without content – nobody can tell what app it is.
